description: In one level over two databases, does Rollback reverse both changes when A was changed first and B second? Workspaces(0) with db = OpenDatabase(main, writable) and dbb = Workspace.OpenDatabase(second file B, writable) before any level; A = UPDATE T SET V = 101 WHERE ID = 1 on db; B = UPDATE T SET V = 5001 WHERE ID = 1 on dbb (both dbFailOnError). BeginTrans; A then B; read both; Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; read both; close both; read both through a fresh Workspace.
